request_summary: [warm-start] I prefer code reviews that quote the exact diff instead of summarizing it.

input.content:
---
name: code-review-exact-diff
description: When reviewing code, quote the exact diff lines instead of summarizing changes
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

When performing code reviews, always quote the exact diff (the relevant `+`/`-` lines from the changeset) inline with comments, rather than paraphrasing or summarizing what changed.

**Why:** The user prefers to see the precise code being discussed so they don't have to cross-reference the original diff. It makes feedback concrete and unambiguous.

**How to apply:** In any code review, paste the specific lines from the diff next to each comment or suggestion. Avoid vague references like "the change to the auth function" — instead, show the exact added/removed lines.

input.old_string: - [Build dir Linear project](linear-build-tracking.md) — infra bugs in Linear project BUILD
input.new_string: - [Code review exact diff](feedback_code_review_exact_diff.md) — quote exact diff lines in reviews, don't summarize

response.text: Got it — I'll make sure to quote the exact diff lines inline when reviewing code, so you can see precisely what's being discussed without having to cross-reference. Saved this for future sessions.
